free_tier.stated: no service and no account; a Rust library and the boringtun-cli binary

egress.terms: not applicable; the software states no volume; ingress: none

tooling: cargo install boringtun-cli; Rust library for embedding
chaining: sits under a WARP client or under a wrapper; it composes with cloudflare-warp and adds nothing to a hosted tunnel by itself.
binding_note: boringtun adds no path of its own: it encrypts and decapsulates over UDP exactly as the protocol specifies, so a UDP block stops it
reliability_note: README warns the master branch is mid-restructure; use the crates.io releases
confidence_note: the verdict is about egress, not quality: boringtun is load-bearing inside the official Cloudflare WARP apps, and is the substrate a wrapper needs

evidence.proved: "an implementation of the WireGuard protocol designed for portability and speed", deployed on millions of iOS and Android consumer devices
"It implements the underlying WireGuard protocol, without the network or tunnel stacks" - the library half does no I/O at all
release boringtun-cli-0.5.2 published 2022-07-20; last push 2026-06-29; 7230 stars
"Boringtun is currently undergoing a restructuring. You should probably not rely on or link to the master branch right now"

notes: Included because brief names it, and because the distinction matters: it is a WireGuard implementation, not a transport wrapper. It cannot carry a datagram across a network that drops UDP, and the library half has no network stack to do it with. Its practical role in this topic is as the engine inside WARP clients, which is where the .conf from wgcf ends up on a mobile device.

extras.wg_detail: boringtun-cli is a userspace WireGuard executable that takes the standard interface configuration, so a normal .conf drives it
extras.volume_stated: not applicable; the software states no volume
extras.transit_note: carries the client's own traffic to whatever peer it is configured against
extras.hosting_requirement: none beyond the device, but no far end either: it needs a WireGuard peer and speaks only UDP to it
